_doc: Registry classification for acquisitions whose manifest.json / processing.json does not state theme, data class or suitability (docs/urbanos/INFRASTRUCTURE_DATA.md §1). Applied by `python -m datasets.importer` at registration, and to already-registered versions whose class/suitability is still NULL (fill-only: a value a manifest states is never replaced; versions stay immutable otherwise). Raw files are never edited. Keys are dataset ids (= the directory name under raw/ or derived/). Every entry carries its reason. `correct_stated_class` {from, to, reason} is the one exception to fill-only: it replaces a manifest-STATED class word equal to `from` at registration; for an already-registered version the corrected metadata registers as a new version (pending review), never an edit. Written 2026-11-13 IST by the infra/coordination agent from each directory's own processing.json / manifest notes.
_registry_notes: 2026-11-13 IST: processing.json files written by the gov pipelines (gov_common.write_processing: opencity_pune derive, opencity_trees, tree_index, census2011_wards, imd_rainfall, nwdp_groundwater, cpcb_air_quality) and by infra_index before this date carry no git_dirty_datasets key, so whether their pipeline code was committed is UNKNOWN. The writers record it from 2026-11-13 (same key and rule as the geo pipelines' _common.write_processing). Old files are NOT rewritten; datasets.provenance_check reports them as 'UNKNOWN (not recorded)'.

_doc_labels: Labels, fill-only, applied by the importer to new and already-registered entries: datasets.<id>.title only while the registered title is the bare id; sources.<id>.name only while the source name is the bare id; sources.<id>.publisher only while it is UNKNOWN. Names are product names from each directory's own manifest / URLs; publishers only where the manifest names them. Added 2026-11-13 IST by the QA agent (uos-qab). dataset_titles.<id>: display titles (fill-only, same rule as datasets.<id>.title) for datasets whose manifest already states class and suitability; names from each processing.json notes / source name. Added 2026-11-14 IST by the QA agent (uos-qa2).
